current.title: text-overflow
current.description: Ellipsis truncation for text that overflows its container.

current.title: Inline box model
current.description: Margin, border and padding on non-atomic inline elements.

current.title: Native SVG
current.description: Rendering inline SVG from live, Stylo-styled DOM nodes instead of re-parsing it with usvg: shapes, gradients, text, clip paths, masks, images, filters and hit testing.

current.title: Table layout
current.description: Laying out CSS tables with Taffy's new table layout algorithm, instead of emulating them with CSS Grid.

current.title: <select>
current.description: Single-select drop-downs, including keyboard navigation and form submission.

current.title: Subgrid and Grid Lanes
current.description: CSS subgrid, and display: grid-lanes (masonry) layout via Taffy.

current.title: Web Animations
current.description: A new stylo_web_animations crate that runs CSS animations, CSS transitions and script animations.

current.title: Animation and transition events
current.description: Dispatching CSS animation and transition events.

current.title: Sizing keywords for min/max sizes
current.description: min-content, max-content and fit-content for min-* and max-* sizes.

current.title: aspect-ratio
current.description: aspect-ratio: auto && <ratio>, automatic minimum sizes, and transferring min/max sizes through the ratio.

current.title: Font matching ranges
current.description: Matching fonts against the weight, width and style ranges of @font-face rules and variable fonts.

current.title: IME composition
current.description: Composition events from IME input, underlined compositions, IME delete-surrounding requests, and IME state for inputs focused before the window is created.

current.title: Richer accessibility tree
current.description: Fuller support for accessible labels and descriptions, placeholders, tooltips from title, ARIA states and presentational roles, and incremental AccessKit tree updates.

current.title: Pointer capture and widget invalidation
current.description: Pointer Events pointer capture, and a WidgetCx that lets custom widgets request a redraw or relayout.

current.title: :has()
current.description: Enabling the :has() selector, with invalidation after state, attribute and DOM changes.

current.title: Form controls and selection
current.description: maxlength, focusing a clicked label's control, sizing inputs and textareas from size, cols and rows, and ::selection colors.

current.title: Touch fling
current.description: Android-style fling scrolling, with least-squares velocity tracking, spline physics and fling boosting.

current.title: DevTools Network panel
current.description: Recording page loads and network requests for the Chrome DevTools Network panel.

current.title: Blitz on the web
current.description: A wasm viewer for a single web page, and a wasm32 build of the Blitz Browser, for the website demo.

current.title: Pluggable text backends
current.description: Moving Parley behind a compile-time text backend boundary, and adding a winkin backend.

current.title: Layout performance
current.description: Parallel layout of sibling subtrees (prototype), plus caching of grid item placement and line breaking.

current.title: JavaScript embedding hooks
current.description: Hooks that let embedders extend Blitz's experimental Boa-based scripting.

completed.title: Devtools
completed.description: Inspect and edit the element tree, styles (including stylesheet rules), computed styles and box model with Chrome DevTools. Blitz apps can open DevTools themselves, using an embedded frontend.

completed.title: background-clip: text
completed.description: Text-clipped backgrounds, and -webkit-text-fill-color.

completed.title: text-shadow
completed.description: Painting text shadows.

completed.title: mix-blend-mode
completed.description: Initial mix-blend-mode and isolation: isolate support.

completed.title: Masks and SVG
completed.description: CSS masks use AnyRender mask layers (fixing mask-mode: luminance). SVG presentation attributes now map to CSS, and SVG <image> and <feImage> load external images.

completed.title: Fonts
completed.description: font-optical-sizing, falling back to the default font when no listed family is available, the @font-face font-stretch descriptor, skipping unsupported @font-face formats, and font emboldening tuned to match Safari.

completed.title: Float layout fixes
completed.description: Shrink-to-fit widths include floats, and floats and lines that don't fit beside existing floats move down to the next slot.

completed.title: Reversed scroll origins
completed.description: Negative overflow, such as in flex-wrap: wrap-reverse scroll containers, can be scrolled to.

completed.title: <details> :open
completed.description: The :open selector for open <details> elements.

completed.title: Presentational attributes
completed.description: Table cellspacing, cellpadding and valign, <font> face and size, and <hr> color, noshade and size.

completed.title: :focus-within
completed.description: Style elements that contain the focused element.

completed.title: text-indent keywords and word-break: break-word
completed.description: text-indent: hanging and each-line, and word-break: break-word, enabled by upgrading Stylo.

completed.title: aspect-ratio for replaced elements
completed.description: Replaced elements such as <canvas> derive their natural height from aspect-ratio.

completed.title: More robust page loading
completed.description: Stylesheets honour BOMs and @charset, non-UTF-8 pages decode lossily, and failed stylesheets no longer block rendering.

completed.title: Accessibility updates
completed.description: The AccessKit tree refreshes after DOM and focus changes, and images with an empty alt are treated as decorative.

completed.title: Parallel styling in apps
completed.description: Dioxus Native and the Blitz Browser now resolve styles on multiple threads.

completed.title: Faster style and layout
completed.description: Narrower restyle invalidation on DOM mutation, skipping animation lookups for elements that have never animated, cached class atoms, fast paths for simple inline layouts and empty flex containers, and mimalloc in the browser.

completed.title: Renderers
completed.description: The Blitz Browser now uses Skia by default, and wasm builds use the WebGL Vello Hybrid renderer.

completed.title: Stylo 0.24, Parley 0.13 and AnyRender 0.15
completed.description: Dependency upgrades, including Vello 0.12 and usvg 0.50.

completed.title: Winit 0.31 beta 4 and Wayland clipboard
completed.description: The clipboard now uses Winit's clipboard API, which adds native Wayland support.

completed.title: Dioxus 0.8 alpha
completed.description: Upgraded to Dioxus 0.8.0-alpha.3, with Dioxus Native synced from the Dioxus repository.

completed.title: Scripting APIs
completed.description: CSS properties as accessors on CSSStyleDeclaration, and URLSearchParams, in the experimental Boa-based scripting.

highlights.text: Accessibility: aria-label/aria-labelledby, aria-description/aria-describedby, and ARIA level and disabled, selected and expanded states
object-fit for SVG images, and images that overflow their content box are clipped to it
Documents share parsed user-agent stylesheets, making new documents (tabs, iframes) cheaper
More DOM APIs for the experimental Boa-based scripting: Element.attributes, getAttributeNames, clientTop/clientLeft, offsetParent and window.event
Dioxus Native fixes: boolean attributes, unchecking checkboxes and radios, synthetic form events, and cleanup of removed nodes
Out-of-flow hoisting for position: absolute and position: fixed
align-content for block, inline and table layout, and self-alignment of absolutely positioned boxes
Table fixes: row-group and column-group backgrounds, row heights, collapsed border positions
Basic Selection API, innerText/outerText, and offset* metrics for inline elements
Rendering waits for render-blocking resources (no flash of unstyled content)
DOM APIs: elementFromPoint, CSSOM View box metrics, and XHTML parsing
Faster incremental updates: fine-grained style invalidation, incremental damage propagation and ~35% faster painting
Correct paint order for positioned z-index: auto elements
Window chrome controls for custom title bars
New Custom Widget API, with event handling
Blitz Browser: tabs, history, favicons and URL bar autocomplete, plus an Android build
Blitz Browser: a browser UI built with Blitz itself
Mobile support for Android and iOS
Text selection outside of text inputs
Mouse and focus events, and double/triple-click selection
Image cache, incremental style traversal and abortable network requests
Skia and Vello Hybrid rendering backends
Input events for IME text composition
Incremental and parallel box tree construction
Skip redraws on scroll and mouse move when nothing has changed
Font metrics from Skrifa (for font-relative units such as ex and ch)
CSS Grid named lines and areas
Web Platform Tests run on every PR
More WGPU types exposed to custom paint sources
API documentation across the Blitz crates
More robust resource loading when the DOM is mutated
Event handling refactor, with DOM mutation logic moved into blitz-dom
CSS styling with Stylo, and Flexbox, CSS Grid and block layout with Taffy (tables emulated using CSS Grid)
Text layout with Parley, including text inputs with mouse selection
Images, inline SVG, gradients, box shadows and background images
Accessibility via AccessKit, link navigation and hot reloading
